sloka: समासाद्य तु तम् वृक्षम् वसेद्वातिक्रमेत वा ।क्रोशमात्रम् ततो गत्वा नीलम् द्रक्ष्यथ काननम् ॥२-५५-८॥
transliteration: samāsādya tu tam vṛkṣam vasedvātikrameta vā ।krośamātram tato gatvā nīlam drakṣyatha kānanam ॥2-55-8॥

translations.english: Reaching that tree, you may tarry or proceed further. A krosa from there, you will see a beautiful forest filled with dark trees mixed with Palasas and badaris and bamboos on the Yamuna.
